title: Her father's last photo and how he looked in death
summary: She says this is a good late picture; he died at 52 and looked young again in the casket.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: This is a good picture of him too. Yeah. You know, a person that knew him when he was getting older. Yes.
To me it looks different than the others, but I've never seen one of them that old then. That looks different.
And he certainly doesn't look old there, but I mean the others are all when he was just a young boy almost.
He was 52. He was 52 when he died.
Did he live to be 52? Yes.
You know, after my father was laid out, he came back almost as young as this.
That 19 year old looked like that.

He really, it was remarkable how he came back to himself. I never think that he was that. He thought he was a young boy in the caucus. Strange. That's why I keep saying this is such a good picture of him because I can picture him, you know, in that casket and how his features came back so perfectly. Yes. Just like he is there. I have to laugh at him because he did everything. He played in all kinds of people. Now here he is in a soldier's uniform. He got in anything. He used to wear some beautiful white and gold uniforms when he played the carnival parades. And my mother used to do stuff He played in all kinds of... Now here he is in a soldier's uniform. He got in anything. He used to wear some beautiful white and gold uniforms when he played the carnival parades. And my mother used to do those things up by hand. Beautiful. They wore white uniforms when they worked for Anderson. I used to do them up. Well they wore tuxedos too. We had the picture. They had to make changes in winter and summer. This is in the tuxedos. They wear the white suit in the summer. In the summer. And the tuxedo in the winter.
